capabilities: Pin, folder, and reorder open notes in a vertical tab sidebar
Group tabs into spaces for separate campaigns or regions
View two to four tabs side by side in a split
Search and create notes, canvases, and bases from a new-tab launcher
Hide sidebars, toolbars, and other interface chrome
extras: Relies on undocumented Obsidian internals for split view and the launcher, which may break in future versions; cannot be enabled alongside Zen UI because both style the same window parts; makes no network requests; installable via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Atlas Sidebar is a fork of Zen UI by Merlin Kraemer.
problem: Obsidian's default editor tab bar has no pinning, folders, or separate workspaces for open notes, and Atlas VTT users have no persistent shortcut back to their current scene.

relations.evidence: Atlas Sidebar is a fork of Zen UI by Merlin Kraemer.
While Atlas is enabled, an Atlas pin spans the top of the tabs sidebar

summary: A browser-style vertical tab sidebar with pinned tabs, folders, spaces, split view, and an Atlas VTT companion pin.
